intro: If you want a place in Lamphun town where the rooms are genuinely new, properly clean, and the price is still friendly, Siri Hotel Lumphun keeps coming up in reviews. It's a 3-star midrange hotel in Wiang Yong with 34 freshly renovated rooms. What guests mention again and again is the attentive staff, the bright spacious rooms, and a breakfast that punches above the price. From approx ฿950/night · scored 9.4 from 113 reviews on Trip.com.

body.html: Siri Hotel Lumphun is a small 34-room hotel in the Wiang Yong area on the Lamphun-town side. What gets people talking isn't flashy design or a long facilities list — it's how new and clean the rooms feel. The hotel was recently renovated, most rooms run around 25 sqm with a bright palette and a firm bed, and a detail many reviews praise is the strong water pressure in the shower — the kind of small thing hotels at this price often get wrong.

There are two main room types: Deluxe Twin (two single beds) and Deluxe Double (one large bed), the same size and similar price. Every room has air-con, TV, fridge and free Wi-Fi. It isn't luxurious, but it's complete for a comfortable one- or two-night stay. One thing real reviews flag is that the room type at check-in occasionally doesn't match the booking — it's worth confirming your bed type at the front desk from the start.
"The staff were very helpful and polite. The room is new and clean, comfortable to sleep in, and really good value for the price."

The top compliment goes to the staff. Reviews agree the team is friendly, polite and more helpful than you'd expect for a hotel this size. Breakfast is served American-meets-local style, roughly 7:00–10:00. It isn't a big buffet, but it's made fresh, tastes good and is enough. A few guests gently note the menu is a little limited and wish for scrambled eggs or a dessert — a fair point, but not a dealbreaker.

On facilities, there's a 24-hour gym, a sauna, a massage room, a small convenience store and free parking. There is a small pool too, but don't expect a big resort-style pool. At times it's used for local kids' swimming lessons, so relaxed swim windows can be limited. If the pool is your main reason to book, this may not be your first pick — but if you're after a clean, well-priced place to sleep, the pool is a nice extra.

The location is in Wiang Yong, close to Lamphun town and Wat Phra That Hariphunchai — a few minutes' drive to the temple and the in-town markets. But honestly, Lamphun is much harder for hailing Grab than Chiang Mai; drivers mostly work the Chiang Mai side. If you're not driving yourself, getting around won't be as convenient as you'd like — that's a limitation worth knowing before you book, and it's the town's context rather than the hotel's fault.

Straight up: Siri Hotel Lumphun won't thrill you with design or a view. But within Lamphun-town stays starting around ฿950–฿1,200/night, it's a well-judged pick on cleanliness, freshness and service. It suits road-trippers who want a clean base in Lamphun — sleep well, eat a good breakfast, then head out to the temples. A 9.4 from 113 reviews says clearly that most guests leave happy.

honestSummary: Siri Hotel Lumphun is a well-judged pick on cleanliness, fresh rooms and service at a midrange price in Lamphun town — ideal for road-trippers wanting a clean base. Just accept that it isn't central and that getting around Lamphun really relies on your own car.
honestChecks: If you're not driving yourself — Lamphun is hard for Grab and drivers favour the Chiang Mai side → plan transport ahead or choose a central place within walking distance of the markets and temples.

faq.a: From approx ฿950/night for a Deluxe Double · there are two main types: Deluxe Double (one large bed) and Deluxe Twin (two single beds), both around 25 sqm · prices shift by season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Siri Hotel Lumphun best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for road-trippers exploring Lamphun who want a clean, fresh, well-priced base · focused on a comfortable sleep and a good breakfast before heading out to the temples · not the pick for a full facilities list or a big pool.

faq.q: Does it have a pool and a gym?

faq.q: Is it easy to get around Lamphun without a car?
faq.a: Honestly, Lamphun is much harder for Grab than Chiang Mai, with drivers mostly working the Chiang Mai side · without your own car, getting around is less convenient — bring a car or plan to rent one.

faq.q: How well does Siri Hotel Lumphun review?
faq.a: It scores 9.4 from 113 reviews on Trip.com · guests repeatedly praise the fresh, clean rooms, attentive staff and a breakfast that beats the price · the main gripes are the out-of-town location and the small pool.
